name: Splinter of the Round Table
description: A long splinter of black, ancient oak, carved on one side with part of a name nobody can read.
findText: Inside a battered chest at an estate sale, wrapped in a knight's faded surcoat, you find a long splinter of black oak. When you hold it, you hear, very faintly, a crowd of people laughing around a table.

name: Lapis cylinder seal
description: A small cylinder of deep blue lapis lazuli, carved with an eight-pointed star and a woman with a bow. Rolled on clay, it leaves a picture of a bull falling from the sky.
findText: A dealer in antiquities is so eager to be rid of a small blue cylinder of stone that he nearly gives it away. Since it came into his shop, he says, he has been having dreams of a woman laughing at him.

name: Brass signet ring
description: A heavy brass ring engraved with a star of two interlocking triangles. Candles lean toward it.
findText: In the attic of a house in an old quarter, under a loose board, you find a brass ring engraved with a six-pointed star. The moment you pick it up, every bird on the roof falls silent.

name: Ancient jawbone
description: The jawbone of a donkey, yellow with age and worn smooth along one edge, as if it was once gripped very hard.
findText: In a curiosity shop full of skulls and saints, the owner sells you an old donkey's jawbone for almost nothing. Holding it, you feel absurdly, terribly strong, just for a moment.

name: Bronze spearhead from Troy
description: A leaf-shaped bronze spearhead, green with age, from a dig on the plain where Troy once stood. It still smells faintly of smoke.
findText: A retired archaeologist, clearing out his study, presses a bronze spearhead into your hands. 'From the plain of Troy,' he says. 'I never wanted it on my wall. It always felt like it was guarding the door.'

name: Pearl earring
description: One of a pair of enormous pearl earrings. The other was lost long ago. It smells faintly of myrrh.
findText: At an auction of a ruined family's belongings, you win a single huge pearl earring that nobody else bids on. The catalog says it is one of a pair, and that its twin was 'dissolved in a wager'.

name: Stone from the walls of Constantinople
description: A block of pale stone, scarred by cannon fire on one face and carved with a small cross on the other.
findText: An old priest asks you to help him clear out a church storeroom. Behind the broken pews is a pale block of stone, scarred by cannon shot, with a cross carved into it. He tells you to take it: 'It belongs with someone who will not give up.'
